questions.q: Why is Welch's method better than a single FFT of the whole log?
options: It doesn't need scipy and runs on numpy
It shows the timing of events
questions.explain: Averaging overlapping windows gives a stable spectrum estimate with a set resolution; a single FFT is noisy and depends on the length of the recording.

questions.q: Spectrum resolution at fs = 8000 Hz and nperseg = 1024:

options: Gyro rebound after the stick stops
Setpoint overshoot on entering a maneuver

questions.q: What do you use to read an ArduPilot .bin in Python?
Which part of the flight do you take for a Welch spectrum?
questions.explain: A stationary segment — otherwise the peaks smear.

questions.q: What does a std of the intervals between log rows > 10 µs at 8 kHz indicate?
options: A bad SD card that writes with a delay
questions.explain: A mean of 125 µs with a spread of a few µs is normal.

questions.q: How do the metrics determine the delay between setpoint and gyro?
options: By the difference of the mean values
By the time of the first gyro peak
By the frequency of the spectrum peak
questions.explain: The delay is the shift at which the correlation of setpoint and gyro is maximal.

questions.q: What does a spectrogram show that a single spectrum doesn't?
options: Only the amplitude at one frequency
How noise frequencies change over time and with throttle
questions.explain: A spectrogram is a spectrum over time windows: you can see the motor harmonics crawl with throttle.
